items.prompt: On a 2 by 3 grid, the function has emitted its six distinct cells. What output count checks the once-only visitation invariant?

options.text: 6 tokens in one joined returned line.
options.why: There are n*m cells. Returning one joined line preserves the supplied main contract.

options.text: 2 tokens, one representing each original row.
options.why: The output contains every cell token, not row summaries.

options.text: 8 tokens, because each corner is emitted twice.
options.why: Shared corners must be excluded by updated bounds; duplicate corners violate the invariant.

options.text: 6 returned list elements, one per cell.
options.why: The count of cell tokens is six, but the function returns a one-element list containing their joined line.

items.explanation: There are n*m cells. Returning one joined line preserves the supplied main contract.
